welcomeText: Play the games you open with AnyPS5 on your Mac from this phone.
searching: Looking for AnyPS5 on the Mac
searchingDetail: Keep AnyPS5 open on the Mac, with the phone and the Mac on the same Wi-Fi, or plug the phone into the Mac with a cable.
sameCode: The Mac shows the same code: press Allow.
notFound: Not found? Check that AnyPS5 with phone support is open on the Mac and that both are on the same Wi-Fi. Or type the Mac's address (System Settings → Wi-Fi → Details → IP address).
noGames: No games on the Mac yet
aboutText: Your phone as a DualSense for the PS5 games AnyPS5 runs on your Mac.
vibrationDetail: The game's rumble and trigger effects on the phone
activity.launch: Opening the game on the Mac
motionDetail: Tilting and turning the phone, as the DualSense's motion sensors
remotePlayDetail: The game on the phone, behind the pad. Off, the phone is only the controller
togetherIntro: Friends, trophies and play time, on the Mac, the phone and the web
togetherUseMacDetail: The Mac, signed in to AnyTogether, approves it at once
togetherMacDeclined: The Mac is not signed in to AnyTogether; use your email
togetherSignedIn: Signed in. The Mac can sign in with this account from its settings.
togetherMacAsks: %@ wants to sign in to AnyTogether as @%@
friendsNone: No friends here yet. Add someone by their handle.
voiceMicDenied: Allow the microphone for AnyPS5 Remote in Settings to talk
voiceAlone: No one else is in voice yet
voicePad: The phone stays the controller while you talk
partyIntro: Talk while you play, up to eight of you. The phone stays the controller.
shareFull: Nobody else can watch right now
shareTaken: The host took the pad back
partyNoFriends: Every friend is here or invited
partyOpenDetail: Your friends join without an invite
partyKicked: The leader took you out of the party
messagesNone: No conversations yet. Write to a friend from Friends.
messagesPick: Pick a conversation, or write to a friend from Friends.
messagesFailed: Not sent. Tap to try again
togetherServerDetail: Another AnyTogether server, one you or your friends host. Changing it signs you out.
togetherServerInvalid: An https:// address, or http:// on your home network
remotePlayNoPermission: Allow AnyPS5 to record the screen on the Mac to see the game here
editHint: Drag a control to move it, tap it to change it
messagesUnsendConfirm: Unsend this message for everyone? It can't be undone.
messagesEditLimit: This message can't be edited any more.
pinFull: You can pin up to %d conversations.
readReceiptsHint: When off, people don't see when you've read their messages, and you don't see theirs. Delivered still shows.
photoTooBig: That photo is too big: at most 10 MB.
quotaExceeded: Your cloud storage is full: delete saves or media to make room.
unsupported: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP pictures can be sent.
family: Your family settings do not allow this.
storageOff: This server does not keep photos.
storageDetail: Cloud saves and the media you send share this space on AnyTogether.
privateLead: A name and picture only your accepted friends see, always next to your @handle. Everyone else sees the public ones.
privateNameHelper: Your real name, say. Leave it empty to clear it
privatePictureHint: Friends see it in place of your public picture
askRemoveFriend: Remove %@ from your friends? You need a new request to be friends again.
askLeaveParty: Leave the party? Voice ends for you, and an invite-only party takes a new invite to get back in.
askKick: Remove %@ from the party? They need a new invite to come back.
askClosePost: Close this post? Its requests go with it.
updateRequiredBody: AnyTogether needs AnyPS5 Remote %@ or newer. Friends, parties and messages wait for the update; the pad still works.
updateRequiredBodyVersion: AnyTogether needs AnyPS5 Remote %@ or newer; this is %@. Friends, parties and messages wait for the update; the pad still works.
notificationsLead: Friend requests, invites, missed calls, and messages that came while you were away.
noNotifications: Nothing new. Friend requests, invites and missed calls show up here.
notifySettingsLead: Choose what you hear about. Everything shows under the bell.
nk_lfg_request: People asking in on your posts
nk_lfg_accepted: When a poster lets you in
digestHint: A mail about unread messages and friend requests while you are away, at most every 6 hours. Message text is never mailed.
digestNoEmail: Your account has no email address to mail.
noPushYet: The phone shows these while the app is open; notifications with the app closed are not here yet.
n_lfg_requests: %1$@ and %3$d more want in on your %5$@ post.
callMicDenied: Allow the microphone for AnyPS5 Remote in Settings to call
groupPick: Pick the friends to talk with.
groupFull: A group has at most %d people.
noFriendsToMessage: Add friends first: you can message your friends.
linkBlocked: That link is not allowed here.
linkBlockedDomain: Links to %@ are not allowed here.
cannotMessage: You can only message your friends.
boardsLead: Trophy points, play time and completion, among friends or everyone.
wouldBe: You would be #%d: your trophies are not public, so the global board leaves you out.
wouldBeLibrary: You would be #%d: your games are not public, so the global board leaves you out.
nothingToRank: Play and earn trophies to get on the board.
boardEmpty: No one on this board yet.
boardEmptyGlobal: No one on this board yet. Only players whose trophies are public show up here.
feedLead: What your friends played, earned and reached.
feedEmpty: Nothing here yet. When your friends earn trophies or start a new game, it shows up here.
feedEmptyNoFriends: Add friends to see what they play and earn.
noGamesYet: No games yet. They show up here after playing in an AnyPS5 launcher signed in to AnyTogether.
handleHint: 3 to 20 of a-z, 0-9, _ and . Once every 30 days; the old one keeps leading here for 30 days.
handleNextChange: You can change it again on %@.
handleCooldown: You changed your handle lately; try again later.
handle_dots: No dot at either end, and no two dots in a row.
noLinks: Names and bios cannot carry links.
rateLimited: Too many changes at once; wait a moment.
bioPlaceholder: A line about you and what you play
privacyLead: Your card (picture, name, handle, bio) is shown to anyone signed in. Choose who sees the rest; you always see all of it.
presenceHint: Friends see you as offline. Messages, parties and cloud saves keep working.
presenceUnavailable: Not available on this server yet.
privacy_gallery: Your gallery of photos and clips
searchHint: A friend request to your exact handle always works.
avatarHint: From your photo library, cropped square.
cropHint: Drag to move it, pinch or slide to zoom.
avatarWrongType: Choose a PNG or JPEG picture.
avatarBad: That picture could not be read. Try another one, at least 32 px on each side.
photoDenied: Allow AnyPS5 Remote to use your photos in Settings.
joinCodeDetail: Anyone with it can ask to join · ends %@
joinMakeCodeDetail: Share it or its link; you still say yes to each one
joinWithCodeDetail: Type or paste a code or its link
codeGame: Play Together: join it from the launcher
joinAskedParty: Asked. You'll hear when the leader answers
joinAskedShare: Asked. You'll hear when the host answers
invitedParty: You're invited: join from the invite above
joinInvitedShare: You're invited: watch from the invite in Friends
joinNoSuchCode: No such code, or it no longer works
joinNotACode: A code is 8 letters and numbers
joinTooMany: Too many requests. Try again in a while
joinDeafenDetail: Hear nobody, and your microphone is off
joinDiscordLinkDetail: A discord.gg invite or a channel link
joinDiscordLinkBad: That's not a Discord invite or channel link
joinableHint: Join from AnyTogether in the launcher on your Mac.
lfgNewLead: Say what you want to play. People who are in tap “I'm in”, and you choose who joins.
purposeHint_coop: You host share play, they play along with a pad.
purposeHint_online: Play the game's own online together.
purposeHint_party: Hang out in a party and talk while you play.
purposeHint_trophies: Get a hard trophy done together.
noPosts: Nobody is looking right now. Post what you want to play and people will find you.
noPostsFiltered: Nothing matches. Try another game or language, or post your own.
noPostsOfMine: You have no posts. Post one and people who are in show up here.
noRequestsYet: Nobody yet. You will hear it here and under the bell.
notePlaceholder: Mics on, chill, English or Turkish… (no links)
tooManyOpen: You have 3 open posts. Close one first.
draft_game: A title ID is four capitals and five digits: PPSA01234.
draft_slots: Co-op has room for 3 more players, the rest for 7.
draft_note: The note is at most 140 characters.
liveLead: Share plays their hosts opened to everyone. Pull up a seat.
noPublicParties: No public parties right now. Make yours public on the party page.
partyPublicHint: People find it under Find players. Anyone you blocked, or who blocked you, never sees it.
peopleLead: People you may know, and who plays your games. Only those who show themselves here appear.
noSuggestions: No suggestions yet. Add friends, set the languages you play in, or make your games public to meet people who play them.
discoveryLead: Whether people who are not your friends find you in suggestions and game hubs. People you blocked never do.
discoveryHidden: You are hidden from discovery now.
languagesHint: For “speaks your language” and as your default on the board. Up to 5.
typeKeyboardHint: What you type here goes into the game.
